explainTr: 'Used to' geçmişte düzenli yaptığın ama artık yapmadığın şeyleri ya da eski durumları anlatır: I used to live in Isparta. Şimdi orada yaşamıyorum.
Olumlu: used to + yalın fiil. Olumsuz: didn't use to + yalın fiil. Soru: Did + özne + use to + fiil? Dikkat: did geldiğinde 'd' düşer, 'use to' yazılır.
Belli bir olay için used to kullanılmaz: 'Last year I visited Turkey' (used to visit değil). Used to sürekli bir alışkanlık ya da uzun süren bir durum içindir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'eskiden ... yapardım' ya da '... idim' diyerek anlatırsın. İngilizce bunun için used to kalıbını kullanır: 'I used to walk to school.' Fiil hep yalın kalır, -ed ya da -ing almaz.

reading.title: Life in Isparta, then and now
reading.text:
One evening, Emre has a school project called "Life When I Was a Child." He asks Hafsa to tell him about her childhood in Isparta.

"Life was different," Hafsa begins. "I used to live in a small house near a rose garden. Every summer, my friends and I used to pick roses, and the whole street used to smell sweet. In the evenings, children used to play outside until dark. Nobody used to stay inside with a phone."

"What did you do on weekends?" Emre asks.

"On Saturdays, I used to go to the bazaar with my friends. We used to buy fruit, cheese, and warm bread. The sellers always used to give us a small gift. I didn't use to like the crowd, but I loved the colors and the smells."

Emre writes quickly. "And what about now? Is life here very different?"

Hafsa thinks for a moment. "Yes. In Isparta, I didn't use to drive. I used to walk or take a bus. Now I drive every day. I didn't use to speak English at all, and now I am studying for a teaching certificate. Some things are better here, but I still miss the roses."

Emre smiles. "Maybe we can visit your hometown next summer."

"I would love that," Hafsa says.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hafsa, you always talk about Isparta. What was it like when you were young?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Very different from Texas! We used to live in a small house with a garden.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Did you use to grow vegetables?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, tomatoes and peppers. In September, everybody used to help with the harvest.

script.speaker: Linda

script.speaker: Hafsa

writing.promptTr: Eskiden nasıl yaşadığını ve şimdi neyin farklı olduğunu anlatan bir paragraf yaz (80-120 kelime). used to ve didn't use to kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph about how your life used to be and how it is different now. Use used to and didn't use to.
frames: When I was a child, I used to ...
I didn't use to ... , but now I ...
writing.model:
When I was a child, I lived in Isparta. We used to live in a small house near a rose garden. Every summer, my friends and I used to pick roses. On Saturdays, I used to go to the bazaar and buy fresh bread. Children used to play outside until dark.

Now my life is very different. I live in Texas, and I didn't use to drive, but now I drive every day. I didn't use to speak English, but now I study it for two hours a day. Life here is more modern and busier. I like my new life, but I still miss the roses and the quiet evenings of my hometown.
